item.title: Debbie Harry Makes ‘SNL’ Cameo to Introduce Olivia Rodrigo’s ‘drop dead’ Performance
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's trending report. We're talking about a surprise appearance on Saturday Night Live that's got everyone buzzing. Debbie Harry, the iconic frontwoman of Blondie, showed up on stage to introduce Olivia Rodrigo's performance of her new single "drop dead".
[Short music clip of "drop dead" plays]
Host: Rodrigo was pulling double duty on the show, hosting and performing as the musical guest for the first time. And what a performance it was - she rocked out to "drop dead" in a stunning green and pink dress. The single, which debuted at number one on the Billboard Hot 100, is Rodrigo's fourth chart-topper.
[Short music clip of Blondie plays]
Host: Debbie Harry's cameo was a nod to Rodrigo's guitar-driven pop sound, which draws inspiration from the new wave scene that Blondie pioneered back in the 1970s. The pairing of these two artists was a symbolic moment, bridging two generations of music.
[Short clip of Olivia Rodrigo's monologue plays]
Host: Rodrigo's episode was full of surprises, including a hilarious monologue that poked fun at her Disney Channel roots and a musical parody of her hit song "drivers license". We can't wait to see what's next for this talented artist, especially with her new album "You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love" dropping on June 12.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for this week's trending report. Thanks for tuning in!
